content:
Noor: Heads-up 8: onboarding teams reporting slow index warming and delayed embeddings since 03:50 UTC. Need customer note + renewal risk triage.
incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-23-index-warmup-slow detected 03:50 UTC. 
Felix: Short root cause: a delayed warmup path after a recent scheduler tweak caused lower ingest parallelism for new tenants. We'll write that in plain terms.
Ira: Draft outbound: 

Hi,
We experienced slower-than-normal index warmup for some new tenants between ~03:5004:20 UTC on 2026-03-23. This may have delayed newly ingested docs appearing in search or embeddings-based features. Existing traffic and stored data were not impacted.
What we did: reverted the scheduler tweak and prioritized warmup for affected tenants; normal speeds restored by 04:20 UTC.
Next: full RCA within 48 hours; office hours for impacted teams tomorrow; CSMs will follow up for renewal-impact cases.

Felix: Add credit line?
Maya: Finance OK to offer a standard one-day credit where significant delays occurred; CSMs can request extra credits.
Ira: I'll create two short office hours slots (09:30 & 15:30 UTC) and a 2-question feedback form.
Noor: Can we flag customers with renewals in 30 days and >10% usage dependent on warm-indexing? Sasha from renewals should get the list.
Maya: Action items: 1) Ira send outbound in 25m, 2) Felix paste message to support tickets, 3) Noor generate renewal-impact list + notify renewals, 4) Finance-bot confirm credit workflow.
Finance-bot: Automated credit workflow: apply 1-day ingest credit when support ticket carries tag "warmup-delay-2026-03-23". Manual escalate available.
Ira: Outbound scheduled and sent to affected list (job 220077). Office hours link: https://redwood.events/office-hours/6011112222. Feedback form attached.
Felix: Pasted note into all affected tickets.
Noor: Renewal-impact list shared with renewals team and CSMs.
Maya: Thanks all. We'll post the RCA here when ready and follow up on credits in 72h. Reconvene if any high-severity customer flags. :thumbsup:
